description: Java interface 'ExternalMessage' defining methods and constants for handling external AMQP messages, including headers, payloads, and metadata.

classes.name: ExternalMessage
classes.description: Interface representing an external message with methods for headers, payload, and metadata.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers of the ExternalMessage.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage instance with an added header.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage instance with additional headers.

methods.name: withTopicPath
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage instance with the specified TopicPath.

methods.name: findContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Type header value if present.

methods.name: findHeader
methods.description: Looks up a header value by key.

methods.name: findHeaderIgnoreCase
methods.description: Looks up a header value by key, case insensitively.

methods.name: isTextMessage
methods.description: Checks if the message is a text message.

methods.name: isBytesMessage
methods.description: Checks if the message is a bytes message.

methods.name: getTextPayload
methods.description: Returns the text payload if available.

methods.name: getBytePayload
methods.description: Returns the byte payload if available.

methods.name: getPayloadType
methods.description: Returns the payload type of the message.

methods.name: isResponse
methods.description: Indicates if the message is a response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Indicates if the message is an error.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context associated with the message.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the TopicPath assigned to the message.

methods.name: getEnforcementFilter
methods.description: Returns enforcement filter data if enabled.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns header mapping information.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns payload mapping information.

methods.name: getSourceAddress
methods.description: Returns the source address where the message was received.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source object where the message was received.

methods.name: getInternalHeaders
methods.description: Returns Ditto headers of the signal that created this message.
